entry_points.text: Read, fault, write and cachestat entries cover dispatcher, buffered and splice readers, fault handler, direct with fallback, plus lookup, pin grab and batched release.
Fresh huge creation, vmemmap optimize, slow and fast resolvers, general and huge faults, NUMA policy derivation and anon preparation entries.
Userfault, general mm fault and huge no-page entries check task, locks, context and retry, build descriptor with area and offset, ensure tables and install preserving markers.

exports.text: Buffered read rejects negative offsets and stops at limit with fast then batched path; splice caps by pipe capacity; cachestat validates descriptor; generic ops supply fault and write-prepare with sync fetch.

Faults supply locked folios with retry handling; small and upper installers publish entries; file rmap links coverage; top fault normalizes, checks policy and delegates huge versus ordinary with accounting.

Table alloc creates missing child under address-space lock with single race winner; huge alloc layers per-area, pool and buddy with placement and reservations; controller charges, commits ownership and uncharges.
Pin keeps a reference with exact or biased counts; unpin coalesces runs; huge reuses shared tables or falls back private; migration preserves failures; walks visit every mapping; policy derives node.

hazards.text: Lockless copy must not fault and orders observations; buffered paths sample once and size after validity; fault-around skips poisoned; readahead may drop protection requiring retry; status encodes major, minor, locked, retry, bus, OOM and fallback.

Mmap reports ENOEXEC without read support and ENOSYS where unsupported; readonly over shared-writable reports EINVAL; mkwrite without support reports SIGBUS; callers tolerate nulls and expect races; huge must resample with quota rollback.

Revoked reservations and oversize offsets fail bus error, poisoned fail poison and failed reservations fail OOM; mismatched huge aborts fatally; exhaustion fails current plus retried; subpool without mapping fails busy; wire is fixed size zeroed.
Gigantic tries CMA then contiguity with exclusive short-circuit or always fails; CMA prefers node with retries; pin lookup revalidates after split, retrying on mismatch.

invariants.text: Lockless read needs uptodate without readahead or dropbehind, disables faults and sizes after validity; dropbehind only if clean; hole probing uses exceptional entries else scans; readahead caps huge.
Fault folios need same mapping, index and size under lock; upper refused for disabled THP, misalignment, wrong order, poison or race; write dirties only where writable; anon uses tagged pointer.

Mmap needs read support and readonly rejects shared-writable; direct invalidates with fallback; cachestat checks owner; subpool adjusts use and reserve; global grows via surplus; new folios start unowned.

Reduction needs enabled switch, unreduced folio and power-of-two saving; release syncs except optimized queues; pins skip zero; write follow needs force on private exclusive anon; huge reports full coverage.

Huge faults handle poison, guard, migration and userfault with reservation checks; admission no-ops when disabled else charges; missing huge separates shared cache from private anon; sharing needs contained spans.

locks.text: Invalidation locks mapping only for walk, unmaps before folio work and yields between batches; fault-around uses RCU then table lock; batch adds refs then locks, flushing when full or disabled.

File faults hold shared invalidate protection and prefer trylock with single drop; small install serializes with retest; upper holds lock through rmap; nonexclusive anon needs caller lock; walks take hugetlb read protection for huge only.

Huge faults order fault mutex, shared access, then table lock, releasing outer locks for waits; copy returns with table lock held; subpool and global changes need their locks; remap needs aligned bounds under read lock.

Userfault drops area lock and huge mutex before sleepable path; stability samples under table lock; pud self-locks while pmd assumes caller lock; anon targets root semaphore; huge move orders folio then anon and file locks.

state_machines.text: Fast read repeats bounded batches; slow loop yields and releases refs; cached read retries until uptodate; buffered write loops in chunks; faults report bus, OOM, fallback, no-page or retry with large-to-small dispatch.

Release dispatches zone-device then huge, else detaches cache and buddies; huge free clears owner then temp, surplus or pooled; surplus rechecks; buddy tracks reluctance; optimization restores only walked prefix on failure.
Walk goes depth-first with entry and hole callbacks, retrying on races; LRU insert resolves evictability; pins use exact or biased counts; resolution walks top to leaf with gating.

Forced faults map completion to lock actions; huge copy reuses exclusive else allocates and installs; allocation runs admission then publication; userfault publishes then sleeps; bulk drains huge; huge move validates, locks ordered and transfers.

structs.text: Splice carries pipe ops, page, offset and length; anon stores tagged pointer and offset; fault links area, access, address, page, tables and mask; cachestat has five counters; batches group LRU work; subpools track max, use and reserve.

Anon and file scans walk offset intervals across interval trees with rescheduling; anon groups form rooted refcounted hierarchy where child release drops root and freeing needs zero refs with brief write coordination.
